summary.en-US: Plan University of Tehran meals across restaurants in one weekly calendar, using your existing dining login.

description.en-US:
Loghmeh is an independent, unofficial University of Tehran meal planner. Pick your usual restaurants as colors, see their food options in a weekly calendar, and keep your draft when dining rejects a change.

See existing reservations, move between weeks, and preview pending spending and refunds on a balance ruler. Submit works per restaurant; changing the active restaurant also saves that restaurant's pending changes. When a save reply is lost, Loghmeh checks the current reservations without resubmitting the uncertain change.

The extension requires an eligible university dining account and uses your existing browser login. Requests go directly to dining2.ut.ac.ir: the browser sends its session cookies, and reservation changes include food, restaurant, group, and dining-wallet identifiers. Loghmeh has no backend, ads, analytics, or developer data collection. Restaurant preferences stay local; live account data and drafts stay in memory.

Persian typography, icons, and connection animations are bundled locally. Animations support pause and reduced motion. Loghmeh is not affiliated with the University of Tehran.

The extension is free. Actual university meals require an eligible account and sufficient university dining balance.

version.approval_notes: Independent, unofficial University of Tehran dining client. The extension is built from TypeScript and Svelte 5 using Vite. The attached source ZIP contains the editable src/ tree, scripts, tests, package.json, and committed bun.lock. To reproduce the Firefox package, install Bun 1.4.2, run bun install --frozen-lockfile, then bun run package. The resulting dist/firefox/ is the reviewed extension; dist/loghmeh-0.8.0-firefox.zip is its ZIP. Svelte, Lucide icons, Estedad typography, and canvas animations are bundled locally; there is no remote code or CDN dependency. To inspect the UI without a university account, run bun run preview from the source ZIP and open http://localhost:4173/src/planner.html for fictional menus, or /tests/browser-live-planner.html?connection=redirect for the connection flow. The local preview makes no university requests. Sample menus, simulation controls, and the probe page are excluded from the shipped extension; planner.html?demo=1 does not enable sample mode there. Live mode requires an eligible University of Tehran dining account; no shared test credentials are included. Login takes place on the university site, using normal browser cookies. Only dining2.ut.ac.ir is a permitted request host. Saving and switching restaurant can change real reservations and wallet balance. A lost save reply triggers read-only reconciliation; an unresolved outcome remains unverified until a later status check succeeds. Connection animations never perform requests or control access to the planner, and support pause and reduced motion. Live reads and one intended save were verified by the developer in Zen/Firefox; refund and batch atomicity are not generally verified. See README.md and the repository's docs/live-api.md for the request contract and limitations.
